name: fillable
description: Fillable fluid containers: FILL at a water, fuel or drug source, DRINK to restore thirst or take a dose, POUR between containers, DISSOLVE a soluble drug into water, EMPTY to discard. Gated on the fillable capacity tag (and soluble, for dissolve). A container holds a CARRIER (fluid_type) and, optionally, a CARGO (drug_id) dissolved in it.
